# Voice clips generated by generate_voices.py (Piper TTS).
#
# Format:  phrase [| symbol] [| say]
#   phrase  what the clip represents; letters are spelled with spaces ("c w", "v f o")
#   symbol  optional; default is the phrase with spaces removed -> voice_<symbol>.wav
#   say     optional; text actually fed to Piper when the phrase is mispronounced
#
# Abbreviations are spoken letter by letter, numbers digit by digit
# (see firmware/voice_assets_required_current_software.txt).
